News.Title: Field Reports Online
News.Body:
## Example Section

Command can now push news straight to your inbox. Announcements, community events and development updates will arrive here from now on.

Welcome back to another Incursion Red River Dev Blog.
In this one, we’re taking a closer look at some of the bigger things we’ve been working on recently. We’ve made improvements to AI, added new utility items, and progressed on both Outskirts and Delta. We’re aware of the areas you all are looking forward to seeing more of, so we wanted to give you a preview of where things are currently at.

We’ll also be going over some quality of life changes, smaller gameplay improvements, the new M14 rifle, and a few other improvements that should help make the overall experience feel better across the board.
